title: Finance Reporting Hub
intro: Find the right financial report and supporting tool.
notes: Six fictional examples for demonstrating layout and content structure. Names, descriptions, topics, and tab labels do not describe any actual organization. Configure and review real content privately before use. No live URLs or financial data are included.

reports.title: Revenue performance
reports.summary: Review sales trends by product and region, and compare current-period revenue with plan and the prior year.

reports.title: Inventory overview
reports.summary: Review inventory balances, aging, and reserve trends to identify where working capital is tied up.

reports.title: Cost and scrap analysis
reports.summary: Compare manufacturing costs with plan and inspect scrap trends by site, product, and reason.

reports.title: Operating expense review
reports.summary: Compare operating expenses with budget and review the cost centers and accounts contributing to period variances.

reports.title: Month-end status
reports.summary: Check which close activities are complete and identify outstanding tasks by business unit and reporting period.

reports.title: Receivables overview
reports.summary: Review customer balances and overdue invoices to prioritize collections and understand receivables aging across the business.
